item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
what's the reasoning for no attribute tags for these?

From the Tag Guide in O5,

Attribute Tags

This list is intended as a guide to attribute tags, or secondary tags on SCP articles.

Thus, by definition, it excludes everything that is not part of the mainlist (i.e. Tales and GoI formats). Furthermore, no GoI format has attribute tags (and suddenly giving this one attribute tags make it oddly stand out from the standard).

If you express the need to have attribute tags for GoI formats, please forward your suggestion and concern to the Technical Team.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Doesn't that make it that much harder to find things if you're interested in a particular subject? It's not like additional tags take up valuable data space or anything. I don't have a dog in the fight, but what's the reasoning for no attribute tags for these?

item.content:encoded:
Noting the following changes made to the tags:

The tag 'goi-format' is added (in place of 'tale') as this article reflects a GoI format and not strictly a Tale. The tags 'arboreal', 'food', 'medical' and 'organic' are removed since GoI formats do not use attribute tags.
